facts.helpFixtures: Real first-season fixtures: 2026/27 Premier League. A new career in the unedited modern Premier League uses the real opponent order and home/away venues. Calendar dates and every match result are simulated. Example: Everton start at home to Crystal Palace, then visit Bournemouth. Other leagues, custom clubs, edited worlds, older saves and later seasons keep generated fixtures. Sources: Premier League and Sports Illustrated.
facts.helpVar: VAR in modern matches. New kickoffs in modern saves from 2026 onwards use simplified game reviews, not a claim about a real competition's coverage. A reviewed goal waits for confirmation. A ruled-out goal adds no score, scorer or shot stats. A missed defensive foul can earn a penalty, and the actual kick can score, be saved or miss. Example: it is 0-0, a goal is ruled out for offside, then an awarded penalty misses. It stays 0-0. Decisions are saved once and the live viewer and full report show the same outcome. Open the match's ? button to read this again.
